scope: R2 anonymous scientific package; R2 three-species scientific revision archive; R3 P0 and stage0 scientific directories only
limitations: Pattern-based text, container XML/relationship, metadata and PDF text inspection is not a guarantee of anonymization.

Office XML and relationships were inspected and author properties removed from selected published copies. A document with private/contact/path markers in document XML was withheld. Scientific PNGs and embedded Office images were selected by scientific-source provenance; no OCR of image pixels was performed.

PDF page text and annotation references were inspected and public-copy metadata replaced. Unreviewed raster-only pages and embedded attachments are withheld; this does not establish that such files contain privacy.
Removed paths and withheld files can prevent scripts from running without replacement inputs. Existing source manifests describe originals; use the public manifest for published-copy integrity.
No scientific computation, implementation testing or external-source freshness verification was performed.
